verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the Dev Portal, which can publish APIs with public visibility or with private visibility behind authentication, so Kong can limit who views published APIs. Catalog is described as a place for 'governing' APIs but with no role detail. The ACL and authentication items cover API consumer traffic, not who can edit API definitions. Missing for 10: documented roles and permissions for platform users, edit-level permission controls on APIs and collections, team- or workspace-scoped access, and independent corroboration.
